title: AlphaFind v2: similarity search in AlphaFold DB and TED domains across structural contexts.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Figshare API file listing for 10.6084/m9.figshare.31802743 (CC BY 4.0): alphafind-evaluation-data.zip 257,769,754 bytes, results.zip 7,915,896,701 bytes, statistical_tests.zip 9,237 bytes, figures.zip, scripts zip. Downloaded and opened statistical_tests.zip: chain-level comparison n_pairs 2,012-2,016, domain-level n 4,418-4,419; values are mean TOP10/TOP100 TM-score-style retrieval metrics. HEAD on the embeddings DOI 10.58074/mv1w-y227 resolves to an EGI DataHub share page (HTML, size of the embeddings not seen).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Figshare description says the benchmark is 2,050 multidomain AlphaFold DB chains and 4,420 TED (The Encyclopedia of Domains) domains; results.zip holds Foldseek outputs re-scored with TM-scores. Did not open the 258 MB or 7.9 GB zips (over the 50 MB cap).

a1_downloadable.note: Figshare files are public, CC BY 4.0, no login; verified via API listing. Main zips exceed the 50 MB cap so contents not opened.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No measured biological outcome exists. The only targets are structural similarity scores (TM-score, a 0-1 measure of 3D shape overlap) that would have to be computed or taken from the authors' alignment outputs.

a3_inputs_present.note: Structures are deposited (per Figshare description) and keyed by UniProt accession; not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: TM-score is unitless 0-1; statistics CSV opened shows consistent 0-1 means.

a5_enough_rows.note: 2,050 chains and 4,420 domains per Figshare description; statistics CSV shows ~2,012-2,016 chain pairs and ~4,419 domains, consistent.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~0.26 GB evaluation zip; 7.9 GB results zip optional
a6_fits_laptop.note: Benchmark structures fit; full results archive does not need to be loaded.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Opened statistics CSV n (2,012-2,016 chains, 4,418-4,419 domains) roughly matches 2,050 / 4,420 described; small gap from failed queries.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any label is computed from the inputs: TM-scores come from US-align on AlphaFold-predicted structures, so a model predicting them is distilling an alignment tool on predicted (not measured) structures. Leakage by construction and circular.

existing_models.name: Foldseek (structure search tool, cited in the paper)
existing_models.score_and_split: Mean TOP10 0.599 vs AlphaFind v2 0.733 on 2,016 multidomain chains (from opened statistics CSV).

existing_models.name: Merizo-search / Foldclass (embedding-based domain search, cited in the paper)
existing_models.score_and_split: Mean TOP10 0.865 vs AlphaFind v2 0.947 on 4,418 TED domains (from opened statistics CSV).

backbone.name: ESM-2 (protein language model) would apply in principle

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: None beyond benchmarking structure search; the join adds no measured biology.

honest_claim_h3: A model here could only claim to approximate US-align TM-scores between AlphaFold-predicted structures, not any measured property.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequences or structures to predict how similar in 3D shape two predicted proteins are.
plain_idea.train_on: Pairs of AlphaFold-predicted protein chains or domains from a 2,050-chain / 4,420-domain benchmark.
plain_idea.predict: Shape-similarity score between two structures, which comes from an alignment program run on predicted structures, not from any lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: fast structure search is already served by Foldseek, Merizo-search and AlphaFind itself, and the target is computed rather than measured.

ml_idea: Learn embeddings that rank structural neighbours as US-align would; this is the paper's own method and the label is computed from the inputs.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Ask whether any column is a lab measurement rather than an alignment score; answer from the opened stats file and description is no.

verdict_reason: A tool paper whose only possible labels are TM-scores computed by US-align on AlphaFold-predicted structures (A2, A8 fail); no measured biological outcome, and the task is served by open tools (Foldseek, Merizo-search).
